# Composer

- Project: https://getcomposer.org · source: https://github.com/composer/composer
- **Not bundled:** WEBit downloads the latest stable `composer.phar` on request from getcomposer.org into `data\modules\composer\`, verified with the published SHA-256 checksum. It runs with the PHP module's `php.exe`.
- License: **MIT** – https://github.com/composer/composer/blob/main/LICENSE
- Packages installed by Composer (e.g. Laravel and its dependencies) are governed by their own licenses.
